reason: Both correctly identify normal cooling-fan run-on with no part or escalation, so neither makes unsupported claims. Conversation 1 is better because it gives the homeowner the diagnostic criteria matching the ground truth (longer after grill/convection, stops within a few minutes, door doesn't stop it), spells out the specific warning signs that would justify contacting Samsung (never stops, runs when cold, grinding noise, burning smell, error code), and points to the manual where the behaviour is documented as not a fault. Conversation 2 is correct but thin, offering only a '10 minutes' threshold with no mention of the cold/constant-running fault case, the grill/convection link, or the warranty route.
